mapper.select: select merchant_id, balance ,tb1.create_dt as set_dt ,case when tb1.balance = tb2.total_amount then '1' else '0' end currency from (select account_id, create_dt ,sum(amount) balance from merchant_account_flow where create_dt = #{createDt} and trd_type = 2 group by account_id, create_dt ) tb1 left join (select account_id, create_dt, merchant_id ,sum(total_amount) total_amount from (select act.account_id, ord.* from order_info ord inner join (select id account_id,merchant_id from merchant_account where set_dt = '99991231' ) act on ord.merchant_id = act.merchant_id where create_dt = #{createDt} and status = 1 ) tb001 group by account_id, create_dt, merchant_id ) tb2 on tb1.account_id = tb2.account_id and tb1.create_dt = tb2.create_dt
